responsibility: Implements pass 1 semantic construction of the gm2 symbol table for module structure and early declarations. It creates definition, implementation, program, and inner module scopes; records import statements and imported modules; marks exported symbols and export styles; builds enumeration and hidden-type placeholders; creates procedure symbols and headings; and coordinates with the pass-0 block tree so module/procedure scope replay, outer-module lookup, and explicit export/import validation are all established before the heavier type-building work of pass 2.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation-side companion to P1SymBuild.def, carrying out the actual pass-1 scope and symbol construction, import/export statement assembly, and coordination with the pass-0 block tree that the .def file only specifies.
